title: He Didn't Eat for 382 Days
lines: [deadpan] A man once went three hundred and eighty-two days without real food.
[amused] Scottish, twenty-seven, with doctors watching the whole time.
[grumpy] I'd like to speak to a manager.
Water, vitamins, and not one lunch. He lost over a hundred kilos.
[weak] Day two hundred. I'm talking to a spoon.
[warm] Five years later, he'd kept most of it off.
[gentle, serious] Please don't try this. He had a hospital. You have a fridge.
sources: IFLScience, 'How did a man survive without eating food for 382 days' (cites Stewart & Fleming, Postgraduate Medical Journal, 1973: 27-year-old Scottish man, 206 kg to 81 kg, 88 kg five years later, supervised at Dundee, potassium/sodium/vitamin supplements and small amount of yeast)
